content.title: Exact monogamy of steering and remote Wigner negativity for multimode Gaussian nodes
content.abstract: Optical quantum networks route correlations through nodes that hold several modes and are linked to many neighbors. Steering is the correlation behind one-sided device-independent tasks and behind the remote preparation of non-Gaussian states. It is monogamous for a single mode, which can be steered by only one party, but how many neighbors can steer a node with $k$ modes was not known. We show that for Gaussian states the answer is exactly $2k-1$ when the neighbors use Gaussian measurements, with any number of measurement settings. The limit follows from a simple bound.
